STEP1.TITLE: 01 · Reference data & subject

ADMIN_HOME.TITLE: Administration
ADMIN_HOME.SUBTITLE: Payroll set-up: parameter sets, countries, line items, benefits, advance rules and change log.

COUNTRIES.HINT: Payroll engine set-up per country. A country missing or inactive here has no line items and no payroll calculation.
COUNTRIES.EMPTY: No country is configured in the payroll engine.
COUNTRIES.FOREX_HINT: Optional. JSON: an array (one entry per source) or an object.
COUNTRIES.DEACTIVATE_WARNING: An inactive country no longer has engine line items or payroll calculation.
COUNTRIES.ERR_FOREX: Exchange-rate sources: invalid JSON (array or object expected).

AUDIT.HINT: Changes to employees' payroll configuration and salary advance status changes, newest first.
AUDIT.NO_PAYS: Choose a country to show its log.
AUDIT.EMPTY: No change recorded for this country.

RUBRIQUES.HINT: What the payroll engine computes for a country, in payslip order. Empty list: the country is not configured in the engine (see “Payroll countries”).
RUBRIQUES.EMPTY: No active line item for this country in the engine.
RUBRIQUES.CODE_HINT: Upper case, digits and _ (20 max). Cannot change later.
RUBRIQUES.CONTRACTS_HINT: Empty = every contract; otherwise comma-separated codes.
RUBRIQUES.FORMULA_HINT: Expression over calculation variables (STRATE_1, BRUT, SELF for Newton-Raphson…).
RUBRIQUES.ERR_CODE: Invalid code: upper case, digits and _ (20 max).
RUBRIQUES.ERR_DUPLICATE: Line item {{code}} already exists for this country.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_TAUX: This calculation mode needs a “rate / amount” key.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_BAREME: This calculation mode needs a scale key.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_FORMULA: This calculation mode needs a formula.

MODE_HINT.TAUX_PCT: Amount = min(base, ceiling) × rate ÷ 100 — “rate” key required, “ceiling” optional.
MODE_HINT.MONTANT_FIXE: Fixed amount read from the “rate / amount” key. The base is ignored.
MODE_HINT.BAREME_PROGRESSIF: Progressive scale applied to the base — scale key required.
MODE_HINT.ANNUALISE_BAREME: Base × 12, annual scale, then ÷ 12 (monthly income tax) — scale key required.
MODE_HINT.FORMULE: Formula over calculation variables — formula required.
MODE_HINT.NEWTON_RAPHSON: Iterative solve (e.g. gross from net): formula using SELF + target value key.

BENEFITS.HINT: Benefits in kind of a parameter set (meals, transport, housing…): editable while the set is a draft.
BENEFITS.NO_SET: No parameter set for this country.
BENEFITS.EMPTY: No benefit in this parameter set.
BENEFITS.READONLY_STATUS: “{{status}}” set: its benefits can only be edited while it is a draft. To change them, create a new set.
BENEFITS.READONLY_RIGHT: You are not allowed to edit parameter sets.
BENEFITS.ERR_DUPLICATE: Code {{code}} already exists in this set.

ENGINE_PARAMS.HINT: Rates, amounts, ceilings and scales the engine uses to compute payroll, by version. Only the active version is used.
ENGINE_PARAMS.READONLY: Read-only version: only a draft can be edited. Create a new version to change values.
ENGINE_PARAMS.MISSING_KEYS: Missing parameters, used by active line items: {{keys}}. Submission will be refused.
ENGINE_PARAMS.KEY_HINT: Letters, digits, _ and . (50 max). The name line items refer to.
ENGINE_PARAMS.NUMBER_HINT: A rate is entered as a percentage: 9.18 for 9.18 %.
ENGINE_PARAMS.BAREME_HINT: JSON array of brackets {"min", "max" (null = open), "rate" in %}.
ENGINE_PARAMS.EMPTY: No version for this country. Create one with “New version”.
ENGINE_PARAMS.DRAFT_CREATED: Version {{version}} created as a draft, from the active version.
ENGINE_PARAMS.DELETE_USED: Parameter {{key}} is used by {{codes}}: without it the version cannot be submitted. Delete it anyway?
ENGINE_PARAMS.ERR_KEY: Invalid key: letters, digits, _ and . (50 max).
ENGINE_PARAMS.ERR_DUPLICATE: Parameter {{key}} already exists in this version.

ERR_VALUE.bareme: Invalid scale: array of numeric {"min", "max", "rate"} brackets, "max" ≥ "min".

SUBMIT.TITLE: Submit version {{version}}
SUBMIT.BODY: The version will no longer be editable. It must be approved by HR then Finance before activation.

APPROVE_HR.TITLE: Approve version {{version}} (HR)
APPROVE_HR.BODY: The version then goes to Finance approval.

APPROVE_FINANCE.TITLE: Approve version {{version}} (Finance)
APPROVE_FINANCE.BODY: The version can then be activated.

ACTIVATE.TITLE: Activate version {{version}}
ACTIVATE.BODY: It will be used for every next payroll calculation of the country. The current active version will be archived.
